description: This file defines React components and logic for the 'Mask' feature within a chat application, including mask management UI, editing, importing/exporting masks, and context prompt handling.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Helper function to reorder list items for drag-and-drop operations.

methods.name: MaskAvatar
methods.description: Component to display avatar based on mask's avatar or model.

methods.name: MaskConfig
methods.description: Component to edit mask configuration, including avatar, name, sharing, and model settings.

methods.name: ContextPromptItem
methods.description: Component representing a single context prompt with role and content editing.

methods.name: ContextPrompts
methods.description: Component managing a list of context prompts with drag-and-drop reordering and editing.

methods.name: MaskPage
methods.description: Main page component for managing, searching, editing, importing, and exporting masks.
